correctness.rationale: Inspected the nine explicit homogeneous harmonic sector bases and reconstructed normalized full-sphere and cap circular integrals using exact even monomial moments. Independent SymPy integration verified the four branch formulas, orthogonality of all nine candidate basis directions, weighted trace lambda_A+2lambda_E+3lambda_T+3lambda_U=27(1-c), and algebraic difference factorization. The A-U difference is a positive factor times Q(u)=495u^3-645u^2+237u-23 on u in [1/2,1]; Q is strictly convex there, negative at 1/2 and 7/10, positive at 3/4, giving one crossing. Exact signed sector comparisons show E and T cannot dominate either U before or A after crossing. c=1 excluded and cap-boundary null overlap at c=1/sqrt2 harmless. Finite quadrature is corroborative rather than the proof.

final_claim: For six disjoint octahedral spherical caps on S^2 with 1/sqrt2<=c<1, the concentration form on pure degree-four spherical harmonics has four explicit eigenvalue branches in dimensions 1,2,3,3; the maximizing branch switches once from the 3-dimensional U sector to the 1-dimensional A sector at the unique root of 495c^6-645c^4+237c^2-23, with a four-dimensional top eigenspace exactly at the crossing.
limitations: Only pure l=4 spherical harmonics, six equal nonoverlapping caps, 1/sqrt2<=c<1; no general bandlimited/overlapping/unequal-weight assertion.
